title: 3.7 Where Are You From?
unit_outcome: Introduce yourself and others in Spanish: name, age, where you are from, your job and what you have.
goal: Say where you are from and your nationality: Soy de México. Soy mexicana.
grammar_function: ¿De dónde eres? Soy de + country; soy + nationality (-o/-a).
